statement_changes.after: (fun r => (r.1, r.2.1, clean r.2.1.2, r.2.2, cache)) <$> (tailCE setup.hmac index (.inl (.inl input))).run (native, recorded) = (fun r => (r.1.1, native, r.1.2.1, (r.1.2.2).map (fun mark => (mark.1, coordsOf input)), r.2)) <$> (simulateQ (publicLocalV Output) ((resumeTail setup.hmac index (factoredServices setup codec checks) (.inl (.inl input))).run (clean native.2, marks))).run cache
